text:
Riley: Hey — Ive got 2x SF Jazz Fest tickets for this Sat (May 2, evening set). Can't make it last-minute, offering them free to whoever can pick up from SOMA office tonight. Also have a small Ikea Kallax (3x1, white) in decent shape if someone wants both. Pics: https://imgur.com/abc123

Sam: I'll take the tickets if they're still available. Can swing by after work (~6:30pm).

Riley: Yep! 6:30 works. I'll leave them with the front desk under "Riley" — say you're picking up for me. DM me your phone and I'll confirm.

Priya: Interested in the Kallax — roomy enough for vinyls? :eyes: If it's still there after Sam grabs the tix, I'll pick it up.

Ethan: Quick Q on the Kallax measurements? Thinking it might fit in my car if it's the 3x1.

Riley: Measurements: `77cm x 30cm x 39cm` (approx). It's the short/wide one, pretty lightweight. Has a couple of scuff marks on the side but no structural issues.

Sam: DM'd you, Riley. Thanks! :thumbsup:

OfficeBot: Reminder: building access doors lock at 7:00pm tonight. Please coordinate with Facilities if you need after-hours pickup.

Priya: Thanks for the heads up, OfficeBot. If Sam grabs the tickets by 6:30 I can swing by at 6:45 and pick up the shelf before 7.

Riley: Perfect. Priya, Ill put the Kallax in storage closet B with a Post-it that says "For Priya". Sam, enjoy the show! If anything changes I'll post here. :sparkles:

Sam: Awesome, thanks Riley!

Priya: You're a legend, Riley. Will bring help for lifting.

Riley: Thanks y'all. If the shelf doesn't work out, I'll post here again before tomorrow.

Ethan: If it ends up free after Priya, I'd be happy to take it — cheers.

Priya: Noted, I'll check back here after pickup in case anyone else is next in line.

(Reaction: Sam reacted with :ticket: to Riley's first message)
